notes: Chat thread with an embedded exchange POSITION panel - this is the cleanest read of the same panel that appears garbled in IMG_7801. Dates DD/MM/YYYY. THE ONE EXPLICIT POSITION IN THIS BATCH: 'LINK/USD ... Long' shown at 16/03/2026 06:54 with '+45.52%' profit. Panel values as OCR'd: NET VALUE $252.432.51, gain '+579.141.40 (+45.52%)', COLLATERAL $172.898.81, then $8.7933 and $7.3229, plus '$1,000,814.99 Orders (1)'. RECONCILIATION (arithmetic only, no invention): $252,432.51 - $172,898.81 = $79,533.70 = 46.0% of collateral, so the OCR'd '+579.141.40' is almost certainly '+$79,141.40' with the dollar sign misread as a 5; net/1.4552 = $173,469 which matches the stated collateral. I have therefore recorded percent 45.52 (unambiguous) but left pnl.value NULL rather than write a number OCR cannot confirm. PRICE FIELDS ARE UNRESOLVED ON PURPOSE: three labels but only two values. Taking entry $8.7933 / mark $7.3229 would mean a LONG in loss, which contradicts +45.52%; the reverse (entry $7.3229, mark $8.7933) gives a +20.08% price move that would need ~2.27x leverage to become +45.52% on collateral. Both readings are inference, so entry/stop/target stay null and both numbers sit in levels.other. The '5.79%' beside 'LINK/USD ... Long' is unexplained - it could be a 24h change, funding, or portfolio weight - so it is not recorded as leverage or size. '$1,000,814.99' appears to be an account-level value, not this position's size. VERIFIED: 14 March 2026 really was a Saturday, so 'Today is staturday' is internally consistent; note the app timestamp reads 17:46 while he writes '(1:45 pm)', a timezone offset of about 4 hours to bear in mind when aligning any of his stamps to UTC candles. The 16/03 07:09 'went parabolic' line is retrospective, not a forward call, so it is kept out of claims.
